overheadPolicyChange.reason: Range attribution in matched scenes; disclose CPU interval perturbation for each ABBA pair.

gp-stable-a.reason: Historical spectator flying FOV was wider than the initial grounded creative birch camera. The unmodified F2 landmark correlations failed.

interpretation.units: GPU elapsed timestamps in ms; CPU render-return intervals include swap. Two measured orders.
interpretation.pooled: Nearest-rank percentiles across accepted frames from both orders for each pack and scene.
interpretation.paired: Newer minus older within A and B; mean weights the two orders equally. Percentile deltas are non-additive.
interpretation.decomposition: Mean deltas of direct frame children plus uncovered time add to the mean GPU frame delta.
interpretation.roomContrast: Night versus noon also changes the roof and time; use the matched birch torch toggle for lamp cost.
interpretation.roomProjection: Same physical room, pose and base FOV. The 1.8.0/p3 pair uses FOV effects 1.0, the p7/p8 pair 0.0. The older view is wider (central crop factor 1.136 matches landmarks). p7 is context only across pairs.
interpretation.rangeLimits: Elapsed ranges include waits and batched submissions. No shader instruction, register, occupancy, lamp-ray or water-only counter.
interpretation.entities: Iris 1.8.8 Entities falls back to TexturedLit for stable and p3. separateEntityDraws defaults false on stable and is true on p3.
interpretation.overheadApplicability: Direct overhead controls were acquired on p7 rooms. Older packs and birch have profiled measurements only.
